usedFor: Fullstory studies how people use your product, and “Create User” adds a user to it.

bestTemplate.name: “Payment Received” in PayHere, then “Create User” in Fullstory
bestTemplate.why: A payment shows a real customer, and the action creates that user in Fullstory.

watchOut: “Create User” adds a user each time it runs, so check you do not send the same person twice.
